Welcome to my data analytics blog.

![](thumbnail.jpg)

The focus is analyzing data from everyday life. Posts will discuss a wide range of topics including science, sports, and society - politics, policy, and punditry.

Some posts will highlight the hypothetical showing how changing one number alters others. Others will be thoughts, ideas, and opinions commingled with facts, data, and statistics.
